library BCS version '2026'
using HEDIS version '2026'

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<Date>

valueset "Mammography": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1168'
valueset "Bilateral Mastectomy": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1042'
valueset "Unilateral Mastectomy Left": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1334'
valueset "Unilateral Mastectomy Right": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1335'
valueset "History of Bilateral Mastectomy": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1140'

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") between 52 and 74
    and Patient.gender = 'female'

define "Denominator":
  "Initial Population"
    and exists([Coverage] C
               where C.type = 'medical'
                 and C.period overlaps "Measurement Period")

define "Numerator":
  exists([Procedure: "Mammography"] M
    where M.date during Interval[
      start of "Measurement Period" - 2 years,
      end of "Measurement Period"])

define "Denominator Exclusion":
  exists([Procedure: "Bilateral Mastectomy"] B
    where B.date before end of "Measurement Period")
  or exists([Condition: "History of Bilateral Mastectomy"])
  or (
    exists([Procedure: "Unilateral Mastectomy Left"] L
      where L.date before end of "Measurement Period")
    and exists([Procedure: "Unilateral Mastectomy Right"] R
      where R.date before end of "Measurement Period")
  )

library CBP version '2026'
using HEDIS version '2026'

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<Date>

valueset "Essential Hypertension": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1122'
valueset "Systolic Blood Pressure": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1290'
valueset "Diastolic Blood Pressure": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1070'
valueset "ESRD": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1083'
valueset "Kidney Transplant": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1163'
valueset "Pregnancy": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1219'
valueset "Nonacute Inpatient": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1189'

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") between 18 and 85
    and exists([Condition: "Essential Hypertension"] H
      where H.date during Interval[
        start of "Measurement Period" - 1 years,
        start of "Measurement Period" + 6 months])

define "Denominator":
  "Initial Population"
    and exists([Coverage] C
               where C.type = 'medical'
                 and C.period overlaps "Measurement Period")

define "Most Recent Systolic":
  Last([Observation: "Systolic Blood Pressure"] S
    where S.date during "Measurement Period"
    and S.status = 'final')

define "Most Recent Diastolic":
  Last([Observation: "Diastolic Blood Pressure"] D
    where D.date during "Measurement Period"
    and D.status = 'final')

define "Numerator":
  "Most Recent Systolic".numericValue < 140.0
    and "Most Recent Diastolic".numericValue < 90.0

define "Denominator Exclusion":
  exists([Condition: "ESRD"])
  or exists([Condition: "Kidney Transplant"])
  or exists([Condition: "Pregnancy"] P
    where P.date during "Measurement Period")
  or exists([Encounter: "Nonacute Inpatient"] N
    where N.date during "Measurement Period")

library CCS version '2026'
using HEDIS version '2026'

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<Date>

valueset "Cervical Cytology": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1208'
valueset "HPV Tests": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1209'
valueset "Hysterectomy": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1210'
valueset "Cervical Cancer": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1211'

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") between 24 and 64
    and Patient.gender = 'female'

define "Denominator":
  "Initial Population"
    and exists([Coverage] C
               where C.type = 'medical'
                 and C.period overlaps "Measurement Period")

define "Numerator":
  exists([Procedure: "Cervical Cytology"] P
    where P.date during Interval[
      start of "Measurement Period" - 3 years,
      end of "Measurement Period"])
  or (
    AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 30
    and exists([Procedure: "Cervical Cytology"] C
      where C.date during Interval[
        start of "Measurement Period" - 5 years,
        end of "Measurement Period"])
    and exists([Observation: "HPV Tests"] H
      where H.date during Interval[C.date - 4 days, C.date + 4 days])
  )

define "Denominator Exclusion":
  exists([Condition: "Cervical Cancer"])
  or exists([Procedure: "Hysterectomy"] H
    where H.date before end of "Measurement Period")

library CDC version '2026'
using HEDIS version '2026'

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<Date>

valueset "Diabetes": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1077'
valueset "HbA1c Lab Test": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1116'
valueset "Eye Exam": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1088'
valueset "Diabetic Retinal Screening": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1078'
valueset "Urine Protein Tests": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1333'
valueset "ACE Inhibitors": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1001'
valueset "ARB Medications": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1007'

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") between 18 and 75
    and exists([Condition: "Diabetes"] D
      where D.date during Interval[
        start of "Measurement Period" - 2 years,
        end of "Measurement Period"])

define "Denominator":
  "Initial Population"
    and exists([Coverage] C
               where C.type = 'medical'
                 and C.period overlaps "Measurement Period")

// HbA1c control < 8.0%
define "Most Recent HbA1c":
  Last([Observation: "HbA1c Lab Test"] H
    where H.date during "Measurement Period"
    and H.status = 'final')

define "Numerator":
  "Most Recent HbA1c".numericValue < 8.0

// HbA1c poor control > 9.0%
define "HbA1c Poor Control":
  "Most Recent HbA1c".numericValue > 9.0
  or not exists([Observation: "HbA1c Lab Test"] H
    where H.date during "Measurement Period")

// Eye exam sub-measure
define "Eye Exam Performed":
  exists([Procedure: "Eye Exam"] E
    where E.date during Interval[
      start of "Measurement Period" - 2 years,
      end of "Measurement Period"])
  or exists([Procedure: "Diabetic Retinal Screening"] R
    where R.date during "Measurement Period")

// Nephropathy screening sub-measure
define "Nephropathy Screening":
  exists([Observation: "Urine Protein Tests"] U
    where U.date during "Measurement Period")
  or exists([MedicationOrder: "ACE Inhibitors"] A
    where A.date during "Measurement Period")
  or exists([MedicationOrder: "ARB Medications"] B
    where B.date during "Measurement Period")

library COL version '2026'
using HEDIS version '2026'

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<Date>

valueset "Flexible Sigmoidoscopy": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1102'
valueset "FOBT": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1093'
valueset "FIT-DNA": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1420'
valueset "CT Colonography": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1421'
valueset "Colorectal Cancer": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1065'
valueset "Total Colectomy": 'hedis:2.16.840.1.113883.3.464.1004.1316'

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") between 46 and 75

define "Denominator":
  "Initial Population"
    and exists([Coverage] C
               where C.type = 'medical'
                 and C.period overlaps "Measurement Period")

define "Numerator":
  exists([Procedure: "Colonoscopy"] P
    where P.date during Interval[
      start of "Measurement Period" - 10 years,
      end of "Measurement Period"])
  or exists([Procedure: "Flexible Sigmoidoscopy"] S
    where S.date during Interval[
      start of "Measurement Period" - 5 years,
      end of "Measurement Period"])
  or exists([Observation: "FOBT"] F
    where F.date during "Measurement Period")
  or exists([Observation: "FIT-DNA"] D
    where D.date during Interval[
      start of "Measurement Period" - 3 years,
      end of "Measurement Period"])
  or exists([Procedure: "CT Colonography"] C
    where C.date during Interval[
      start of "Measurement Period" - 5 years,
      end of "Measurement Period"])

define "Denominator Exclusion":
  exists([Condition: "Colorectal Cancer"])
  or exists([Procedure: "Total Colectomy"] T
    where T.date before end of "Measurement Period")
